narrative: Material PL1__M3E92184 exhibits high demand variability (CV=0.82) with intermittent zero-demand days comprising ~28% of working days, and moderate lead time instability with occasional spikes to 5.17 days. The EOQ of ~11,008 units significantly exceeds the MOQ of 660, enabling cost-efficient large replenishments approximately 34 times per year. A continuous-review (s,S) Min-Max policy is recommended, with a reorder point of 5,554 units and max level of 14,422 units, maintaining the 95% service level while reducing annual inventory costs by 85% versus the SAP baseline.
warnings: Lead time spike of 5.17 days observed - monitor for recurrence
High demand CV (0.82) indicates significant forecast uncertainty - review demand drivers

research_insights.selection_rationale: High demand variability (CV=0.82) and variable lead times (CV=0.69) favour continuous review over periodic review. The MOQ constraint (660) is non-binding as EOQ (~11,008) dominates, making a fixed-order-quantity variant of (s,S) appropriate. The storage cap of 22,553 units is not binding at the recommended max-stock level of 14,422 units.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity has ~36% headroom above the recommended max-stock level (14,422 vs 22,553 units). No capacity constraint binds. If demand surges or lead time spikes coincide, the reorder point of 5,554 provides adequate buffer at 95% service level.
